findings.claim: The observed window is the score-clock interval [0.0, 0.5] with 50 observed score nodes at 0.01 spacing, and the curve-support audit reports a selection rule with selected_count 0.0 and curve_fidelity 0.49; recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior applies, so no absolute affinity target is available and last-record credit cannot be read as final affinity benefit.

The declared objective is final predicted target affinity primary with validity and strain secondary under coordinate-only control; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached Hungarian endpoint mean-squared distance and native endpoint VJP, so coordinate contrasts are selection/geometry evidence rather than physical interaction energies or affinity-head derivatives.

Continuous contrast functions over the complete observed support are non-monotone and unstable: landmark_00_soft_mass shows 4 sign changes with first_rate_z +9.27 and last_rate_z -10.00, landmark_00_local_dx shows 6 sign changes with 9 strong sign conflicts, and landmark_00_local_dz shows 10 sign changes; no polynomial fit is accepted and extrapolation is disallowed, so a constant rule is not supported and a time-conditioned rule would need validated observed-node interpolation only.

Local coordinate features at landmark_00 (dx, dy, dz, cxx, cyy) have relative_node_RMSE between 0.41 and 0.78 with whole-window z magnitudes below 0.6, indicating weak whole-window marginal signal and poor fit fidelity; these isolated marginal descriptors do not by themselves establish a coherent joint coordinate pattern.

hypotheses.falsifier: If observed-node interpolation of landmark_00_soft_mass fails to reproduce the sign reversal, or if independent-batch agreement is absent, the time-conditioned rule is not supported.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_soft_mass contrast at observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned contrast rule on landmark_00_soft_mass, using only observed-node interpolation within [0.0, 0.5], would track the sign reversal from positive early rate to negative late rate better than a constant rule.

hypotheses.direction: withhold signed prioritization of landmark_00_local_dx and landmark_00_local_dz
hypotheses.falsifier: A counterexample batch showing consistent same-sign rate for these features across the window would weaken the withholding.
hypotheses.statement: The strong sign conflicts and multiple sign changes in landmark_00_local_dx and landmark_00_local_dz indicate that a single signed direction for these local coordinates is not reproducible across batches.

limitations: No decoded terminal labels or current-study outcome data are supplied, so last-record credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit and the immediate-selection versus descendant-survival comparison is unavailable.

No joint_diagnostics, regional_effects, survival_effects, increment_effects, turnover_accounting, branch_adjusted or lineage_support rows were read in this turn, so multiplicity-adjusted ranking, independent-batch counterexample checks, joint-versus-marginal coupling, and parent-child increment accounting remain unassessed.

The curve-support audit reports selected_count 0.0 and curve_fidelity 0.49; the selection rule and fidelity rule details were not read, so selection enrichment versus absolute geometric descriptor cannot be fully separated.
No temperature edit is proposed or permitted; temperatures are immutable task parameters.

task.formula: R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau), q=detached-Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance; rho_delta=delta^2*(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1). Actual pointcloud_delta_A defaults to 1 A. Native endpoint VJP, no affinity-head derivative, no extra model forward. teacher_neighbors is a count; temporal_recipe changes only a registered scalar/attention, not velocity. No temperature edits. Inert legacy metadata is not a reward term.

formula_registry.diagnostic_limit: Moment effects, pair kernels and turnover are diagnostic evidence. Executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; legacy robust_delta is inert.
formula_registry.dose: Endpoint-VJP force normalized and RMS-scaled against native predictive update; eta/ramp only in U lane.
formula_registry.prior: Detached nearest-k teachers; log_pi=-q_anchor/prior_temperature; scores beta=0; k is a count.
formula_registry.regional: Detached background plus Gaussian landmark attention; positive surrounding weight.
formula_registry.temporal_region: Same static teachers; validated absolute contrast changes regional attention at observed score nodes.
formula_registry.temporal_teacher: (1-blend)*R_static + blend*R_observed_teacher(time); same shared FLOWR endpoint, no velocity target.

incumbent.topology_policy: Free native graph transitions; no pair-distance acceptance or graph equality veto
